description: Returns the Operations board: one lane per function in UnClick, with its traffic light, priority, owners, and whether it is waiting on the operator. This is the standing brief - when nothing is on fire, pull a lane from here the way you pull a chip from the Jobs board. Ranked worst-first (human-blocked, then red, amber, unknown, green). Pass needs_attention to see only what is not settled, group to scope it, include_induction once per session for the standing rules. agent_id required.

group.description: Scope to one group, e.g. autopilot, xpass, xgate, ci.

include_induction.description: Include the standing rules and the recognised human-action reasons. Worth one call per session.

needs_attention.description: Only lanes that are human-blocked, red, amber, stale-claimed, or never reported on.

name: list_lanes
title: List Operations board lanes
